_help: Read by the learner at the start of EVERY cycle, so an edit applies to the next cycle without a restart. Keys starting with _ are ignored. See README.md.
_max_lanes: 12 from 2026-10-15 (USER RULING 38 and its follow-up: the user left 8 vs 12 to Claude). Lanes cost no Claude usage. 12 lanes = 3 strategies a cycle (the incumbent, one Claude proposal, one screening-design row), while 8 lanes = 2, which starves the design while proposals queue (brain.choose_arms). Scale to 16 when the AI player gives the learner something new to test. (8 briefly on 2026-10-15; 16 from 2026-10-07, USER RULING 37 Q7.)
_keep_raw_cycles: 12 keeps every raw log until the next interactive session (measured 1.3-1.7 GB a cycle, not the 4 GB once written here; min_free_gb still guards the disk)
_keep_raw_cycles_2026_10_19: 20 (was 12): the raw batch logs are the AI's EXPERIENCE input (USER RULING 41, backlog A6) and prune() deleted one cycle every 12 h. A full cycle is about 1.3 GB, so +8 cycles is about +10 GB of 78 GB free. The real fix is backlog O3 (gzip, about 37:1, instead of deleting); this only buys time until it is built.
_keep_raw_cycles_2026_10_21: O3 built (backlog; spec S1-1): a cycle older than the newest keep_raw_cycles is now ARCHIVED to runs/<tag>/raw.zip, verified, and only then are its raw logs deleted. A cycle is about 1.3-1.7 GB raw. Still 20 on the first restart, so the new code changes nothing until this is lowered (by a commit, never by editing the clone).
_max_archives_per_prune: how many cycles one cycle boundary archives at most (each about 15-30 s for 1.3 GB); the rest wait for the next boundary. The disk guard and `learner.py archive` are not capped.
_keep_archive_cycles: RESERVED, only 0 is implemented: 0 = keep every raw.zip forever (the archives are the AI's experience input, backlog A6). Nothing in the learner ever deletes an archive.
_design: screen = after the control, run the rows of a screening design that measures each knob's own effect (Plackett-Burman 12 for 11 knobs, Hadamard 16 for 12-15); anything else = Thompson draw + mutants
_auto_update: between cycles only: fast-forward this deployment clone to origin/main, then restart into new learner code if test_agent.py passes
_objective: what the learner ranks strategies by: human_balanced = half progress, half Pokedex owned (USER RULINGS 32/33, provisional); progress = badges/E4/Champion only

consult._enabled: ON since 2026-10-03; KEPT ON by the user 2026-10-15 (06) after measurement: 10 of the 15 best-ranked strategies, including the top 5, came from these proposals. It costs about 2 cheap-model calls a day, and a failed call (e.g. the user's usage ran out) is logged and harmless, never a cycle failure.
consult._max_waiting_proposals: skip a consult while this many proposals already wait in inbox/ (2026-10-17: 12 waited; 2 arrive a cycle, 1 is used), so the user's Claude usage is not spent on ideas that would wait days
